The Cutting Weevil reference images confirm this pattern: the weevils cause notched/scalloped leaf margins (in mild cases) through to completely cut-away leaves (in severe cases). The test image shows the classic early-stage notching pattern along the margin, consistent with adult cutting weevil feeding.
